label: preparing
what: A public civic/community gathering is being organized for 18:00 in the great hall, with committee arrangements for refreshments (including ordered bread), deliveries, and hall lighting. The innkeeper, builder, and freight operator are the committee; the secretary is knowingly supporting through scheduling/escort and inquiries. The baker is involved in baking the ordered loaves, and the neighbour has been informed and plans to attend. No bridge/port changes or treasury spending are proposed; payment on the initial 120-loaf order remains unverified.
